header.title: Your Coffee Journey Starts Here
header.subtitle: Master The Bean Keeper in 4 simple steps

1.title: Capture Your Coffee
1.description: Take photos of your coffee bag - front and back. Our camera makes it easy!
1.details: Tap the camera icon or choose from your device. A clear front photo helps Gemini read the bag if you choose to scan it.

2.title: Scan with Gemini
2.description: Choose Scan with Gemini to get suggestions for roaster, origin, variety, flavor notes, and more.
2.details: Review the suggestions and apply the ones you want. You can also enter details manually.

3.title: Review Your Coffee Details
3.description: Check the details against the bag and edit anything Gemini missed.
3.details: Your changes stay in the form. Save when the coffee details look right.

4.title: Build Your Collection
4.description: Your coffee is saved! Track your journey, discover patterns, and never forget a great roast.
4.details: Browse your collection, filter by origin, see stats, and relive every coffee moment.
